headlines: Election Day: US markets open, midterm outcome in focus
SHOP about -9.5% and PLTR about -5% on the day
FISV +7.6% and AEHR +22% among trending movers

rumors.text: Market has already priced in a Democratic midterm win, so stocks go up either way
rumors.why: If the outcome is fully priced in, relief could lift index ETFs; single-poster speculation

plays.reason: Extreme fear (19), SPY RSI about 38 and crowd bearish suggest a contrarian bounce; tech and small caps are leading (QQQ +0.5%, IWM +0.5%)

readings.whats_new: SPY rose to 753.7 (+0.21%) from flat, while VIX moved up to 21.7 and fear and greed fell to 19 (extreme fear). Stocktwits SPY sentiment is 41, little changed. The Iran and oil rumor from last hour is not repeated in the new SPY chatter; focus stays on Election Day.
